notes.title: Another Bar Game is a part of Steam Cooking Fest!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43359645/42bc103f01d6095b98ecb51b5734bf14d5dfb293.png[/img]

Hey guys! My little bar simulator game just accepted into Steam Cooking Fest with a 40% discount!
You can grab it now for just $2.99! I’d really appreciate it if you checked it out!

If you decide to buy and play, please consider leaving a review - it would help a lot! I just need a few more reviews to boost its visibility. Thank you for supporting indie games!

Thanks,
Arik

notes.title: Game Update Announcement!
notes.notes:
[h3]I'm excited to announce the latest update for Another Bar Game! [/h3]
In this update, players now have the option to choose their preferred difficulty level, allowing for a more personalized gaming experience. Additionally, we've expanded language support, introducing German, Spanish, and Korean languages to make the game accessible to even more players worldwide. I have also implemented several bug fixes.

I hope you enjoy these new features and continue to have a fantastic time playing our game!

notes.title: Another Bar Game out on Steam!
notes.notes:
Dear friends!

Exciting news! Today is the big day – After 1.5 years I’m thrilled to announce that [b]Another Bar Game[/b] is officially released and ready for you to dive into the world of bartending fun! This funny bartender simulator has been my personal experiment to create and finish a game all on my own. I can't wait to share the results with you!

[b]Ready to start[/b] your bartending adventure? 

Grab your copy now with [b]20% discount[/b]! [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2216060/Another_Bar_Game/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2216060/Another_Bar_Game/[/url]

If you enjoy the game, please consider leaving a [b]review [/b]– it means the world to indie projects like this. Please RT [url=https://twitter.com/_arikz/status/1717116260800983433][u]my Twitter post[/u][/url] so the game reaches more people :)

[b]Thank you![/b]

Arik from Arik Games

notes.title: Another Bar Game Demo Showcase
notes.notes:
Showcasing the newest demo for my upcoming title, Another Bar Game

It's a casual action game with elements of time management, simulation, and challenging. In this game, you serve craft beer to thirsty bar guests and strive to keep everyone happy.
Upgrade your bartender skills, unlock new beer types and bars!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43359645/e002493092041a7ea417fb36eb5981cfdde247ed.gif[/img]

notes.title: Demo of 'Another Bar Game'
notes.notes:

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2216060/Another_Bar_Game/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43359645/cfb6f8e669436777e443da4929cb5ee7e0045873.png[/img][/url]
